assessment.summary: IL6R (P08887) is a well-validated, clinically proven drug target with two approved biologic antagonists (tocilizumab and sarilumab). Structural data is solid with 10 PDB entries at up to 2.4Å resolution and 8 ligand-bound structures, though the approved drugs are large biologics and small-molecule ChEMBL activity data is absent. The target remains highly druggable at the biologic level, with ongoing research interest in inflammatory and oncological indications.
evidence_gaps: No small-molecule IC50 data in ChEMBL (0 entries), indicating the target may be challenging for small-molecule drug discovery
Best PDB resolution is 2.4Å, just at the threshold for 'high' structural confidence; no sub-2Å structures available
AlphaFold mean pLDDT of 77.9 with only 67.5% high-confidence residues suggests some disordered regions not well-captured structurally
No information on allosteric binding sites or cryptic pockets that might enable small-molecule intervention
Lack of structural data for the full IL-6/IL-6R/gp130 ternary complex at high resolution limits understanding of the complete signalling interface
No data on resistance mechanisms or target mutations that could affect drug binding
